angle: An AI tool to automatically generate meeting notes from video calls.
hook: Tired of taking meeting notes? This AI can do it for you!
script: Tired of taking meeting notes? This AI can do it for you! Meet Otter.ai, the tool that transcribes video calls in real-time. It captures every word and organizes them into clear, searchable notes. In our testing, it nailed 90% accuracy, letting you focus on the conversation without worrying about missing details. Plus, no need to manually recap later. Follow for more tech tips!
caption_body: Say goodbye to manual note-taking! Would you trust AI with your meetings? 🤔
